messages:
sophia lau: Quick sync — planning a Partner Compatibility Cohort for early April. Goal: coordinate breaking-change notices, give SI/cloud marketplace partners a clear migration runway. Thinking cohort sizes of ~12 partners, grouped by integration type (marketplace, HW SI, cloud-init). :calendar:
ownen park: Love that. Do we have a proposed deprecation cadence? e.g., announce -> 90d grace -> 30d final warning? :thinking_face:
sophia lau: Rough plan: announce (D0), SDK grace window 120 days, opt-in canary for 60 days, final cutoff at D120. For heavy integrators (SI/hardware) we can extend to 180 on a case-by-case basis. Need partner comms and a migration toolkit.
lee chen: Agree on cohort approach. Also suggest a telemetry opt-in flag so we can see integration breakage before announcing public cutoff. Partner privacy-first flag, opt-in only.
ana ramos: @sophia can we include a small script to auto-detect deprecated header usage in partners' code? That would cut support load. Example check snippet:```bash
curl -s -I https://api.redwood.ai/endpoint -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' | grep -i 'x-rw-auth'
```
sophia lau: Yes — devex can produce a lint and a small CLI check. We'll include migration steps and a sample shim. Mike, can eng-runtime ship a compatibility shim for the marketplace agents?
mike thompson: We can ship a network-side shim for hosted marketplace traffic for the 90-day window, but not for Dedicated/Private deployments. We'll document which environments are covered.
owen park: What about announcement sequencing with cloud marketplaces (Azure/GCP/AWS)? They need earlier lead time for listings. Suggest TT = D-21 for marketplace PMs and D-14 for partner account reps.
sophia lau: Good call. Proposed external timeline: Partner cohort announced D0, marketplace pre-brief at D-21, partner-facing docs D+7, opt-in canary opens D+14, telemetry collection D+14->D+74, deprecation final D+120.
lee chen: For SDK bumps, we should publish semantic-minor bump with a clear migration table and a compatibility badge. Also add automated canary rollout steps in docs.
partner-ops-bot: Reminder: run partner_cohort_invite_workflow for cohort-alpha at 1765432120. :robot_face:
ana ramos: We should also prepare a partner-specific rollback runbook. Minimal flow: detect, notify, enable shim, patch, verify. Keep it < 4 steps for SIs.
mike thompson: Ops note — for HW partners we need a separate testing window because firmware updates are involved. Recommend we allocate one extended cohort for HW in May.
sophia lau: Action items: 1) Devex: produce CLI lint + migration guide (owner: ana) 2) Eng-runtime: compatibility shim scope doc (owner: mike) 3) Partnerships: partner invite list + marketplace PM alerts (owner: sophia) 4) Telemetry: opt-in flag spec (owner: lee). Owners, can you ack? :thumbsup:
owen park: ack (will help with marketplace PMs) :thumbsup:
lee chen: ack — will draft opt-in telemetry schema by Friday.
ana ramos: ack — starting CLI lint prototype today.
mike thompson: ack — will post shim scope draft by EOW.
sophia lau: Perfect. I'll assemble the invite email template and a short partner FAQ. If anything urgent ping me DM. Thanks all :raised_hands:
partner-ops-bot: Scheduled: partner_cohort_alpha_invites sent at 1765432200.
